mapper.select: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) FROM order_item oi INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status = 3

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(d.date, '%m/%d') AS saleDate, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) AS amount FROM ( SELECT CURDATE() - INTERVAL (a.a + b.a * 32) DAY AS date FROM (SELECT 0 AS a UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) a CROSS JOIN (SELECT 0 AS a UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4 UNION ALL SELECT 5 UNION ALL SELECT 6 UNION ALL SELECT 7 UNION ALL SELECT 8 UNION ALL SELECT 9) b WHERE CURDATE() - INTERVAL (a.a + b.a * 32) DAY >= CURDATE() - INTERVAL 29 DAY ) d LEFT JOIN orders o ON DATE(o.create_time) = d.date AND o.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status = 3 GROUP BY d.date ORDER BY d.date ASC;
